params.name: instrumentID
params.description: A unique ID created by DriveWealth to identify a specific instrument.

params.name: compression
params.description: The compression number represents the time increments of the chart data. Refer to the Compression table above.

params.name: dateStart
params.description: The start date of the chart data. Follow ISO-8601 format.

params.name: dateEnd
params.description: The end date of the chart data. Follow ISO-8601 format.

params.name: tradingDays
params.description: TradingDays may be defined as 1-60 days in the past from the current date. If set do not use `dateStart` and `dateEnd` values.

items.docs: Fetch historical bars for a given instrument over a given time period.
